transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Thank you for joining this pre-purchase review. As you know, we're considering a vendor's indoor-air-quality monitoring system for the science wing. The preliminary discussion has focused on the six-monitor package at $3,100, though the vendor also offers a nine-monitor package at $4,320. Before I record my approval decision, I'd like to hear from each of you on any findings relevant to this purchase. Let's start with you — what have you found?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: Dr. Morris, I need to share an important finding from my inspection this week. I identified nine separate science-wing classrooms that each require their own monitor because the rooms have separate ventilation zones. My room-by-room report hasn't been entered into the purchasing worksheet yet, but based on this inspection, the six-monitor package would leave three classrooms unmonitored. I'd recommend we consider the nine-monitor package instead.
